sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Rapidly rising star Geneva Lewis makes her Vivo Performing Arts debut with a program of striking emotional range. Lewis is praised for her lustrous tone and rare ability to unite fervent passion with immaculate precision.
body: Geneva Lewis—a rapidly rising star on the international stage—makes her Vivo Performing Arts debut with a program of striking emotional range and intention. Praised for her lustrous tone and the rare ability to unite fervent passion with immaculate precision, Lewis moves from Mozart's surprising, nocturnal G-Major Sonata into the tender longing of Silvestrov's miniatures, the somber weight of Weinberg's survival-haunted sonata, and the electric intensity of Webern. With Strauss' early violin sonata—glowing, love-struck, and radiantly alive—Lewis brings this distinguished debut to a spirited and joyful close.
